objective: Make previously approved/paid BUKLOD self-service advertisements automatically appear as fixed Sponsored slots in the Public Community Wall and desktop-only Home for their entire paid campaign period; automatically stop on expiry, pause, rejection or payment loss without turning ads into permanent posts.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: source at main includes admin approval RPC buklod_admin_review_paid_ad_v1 which sets starts_at=approval time and ends_at=approval time+30 days, with payment verification and policy guards. Production Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu contains 2 approved/paid/nationwide/photo eligible campaigns and 2 pending/unpaid campaigns. Main Public Wall /buklod has an AdMob first-view and inline rows but no BuklodCommunitySponsoredAd; canonical desktop Home is /hub and likewise has no paid card. Existing Community Sponsored component only mounts in legacy local-scope feed and was artificially nationwide-only for public audience, with no focus re-fetch or expiry ticker. Existing ads RLS grants SELECT for approved/paid/waived/policy confirmed and current 30-day dates. Existing table buklod_paid_ad_events has identity primary key and authenticated owner insert policy; prior impression count zero when no paid ad surfaces mounted.
chosenApproach: Use existing paid campaign data and admin approval dates, not a duplicated social post. Add one dedicated paid sponsor card to Public Wall FlashList header, and one to canonical /hub desktop Home only. Upgrade existing sponsored component with focus/foreground/60-second refresh, timestamp fail-closed eligibility, 12-second fair rotation among qualified sponsors, profile geo targeting for public audience, media type preview, and on-screen impression/click event recording. No approval, payment, DB schema, AdMob, native runtime or legacy sponsor changes.
selectionRationale: Auto-live requires no write triggers: paid eligibility is already enforced by database RLS and the admin's 30-day schedule. A permanent UI slot with periodic conditional read automatically shows newly approved rows and hides revoked/expired ones, while avoiding unremovable ordinary posts or Wall data-model changes. Desktop uses canonical /hub branch to avoid showing extra sponsorship on phone Home or all sidebar routes.
alternativeApproaches: Insert permanent Community posts on approval: rejected; duplicate content persists after expiry/pause and pollutes social feed.
Show active paid campaign only in legacy app_sponsors sidebar: rejected; two systems separate and user requests main Wall plus desktop Home.
Publish 2+ large sponsored cards simultaneously in all feeds: rejected for weak-network, video CPU and visual overload; rotate in one slot.
Ignore geo targeting or allow unpaid/pending campaign: rejected; ad buyers pay for specific audience and admin approval is mandatory.
preserveBehaviors: Existing admin approval and separate payment verification, user-scoped paid submissions, 30-day start_at/ends_at logic and approved status remain unchanged.
Existing Google AdMob/AdSense spots, legacy app_sponsors, public profile and Community Wall post render and scroll behavior stay intact.
Public Wall and desktop Home host one sponsored slot each, rotate qualified campaigns, and keep the original social post order unchanged.
Local geo campaigns display only where a viewer's profile province/city/barangay matches, worldwide Public only for nationwide or matched local campaigns.
Managed local scope preserves exact geographical scope matching; organization/cluster scope not broadened without authorization.
Never show pending, unpaid, rejected, paused, expired, invalid-date or missing-media advertisements.
Video only uses existing muted lazy player, with no explicit autoplay and offscreen rotation unmount; no runtime config or native dependency changes.
Only verified in-viewport impressions/clicks are counted and no personal fields exposed.
No unrelated production DB or campaign rows are modified in this source patch.
acceptanceChecks: Already approved paid photo campaigns appear near top of Public Wall automatically after deployment, respecting authorized audience.
Newly approved ads appear within 60 seconds while focused or on re-entry/foreground; paused or expired ads are removed within same bounds and by client clock.
Desktop /hub Home has sponsored creative card; narrow Android/iOS Home remains unchanged.
Multiple ads share one visible slot with 12-second rotation and campaign period remains 30-day server-controlled.
Legacy sponsors, AdMob first-view ads, public post order, geo-targeting and payment approval remain intact.
Focused TypeScript/Node tests, engineering accountability, performance QA and Expo web compatibility pass before RC promotion.
